standard_prerequisites.name: Equivalence between quasi-coherent modules on the small Zariski site and on the big fpqc site
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Descent, the proposition establishing the equivalence between quasi-coherent modules on a scheme and quasi-coherent modules on the big fpqc site, together with its variants for other topologies
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the existence of the quasi-coherent module F_0 on S whose pullback restricts to F, and the equivalence statements of parts (4) and (5).

standard_prerequisites.name: Change of topology for ringed sites
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Descent, the remark describing the pullback along the morphism of ringed sites comparing two topologies on the same category
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the compatibility of the pullbacks under change of topology, which identifies F^a with F_0^a and gives parts (2) and (3).

standard_prerequisites.name: Descent of the sheaf condition along fpqc coverings
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Descent, the lemma that the pullback of a quasi-coherent module satisfies the sheaf condition, together with the proposition on quasi-coherent sheaves for the fpqc topology
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the sheaf property of F^a even for fpqc coverings, hence in particular for fppf and etale coverings.

standard_prerequisites.name: Higher direct images as sheafified presheaves of cohomology, and vanishing of the cohomology of quasi-coherent sheaves on affine schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology on Sites, the lemma identifying the higher direct images with the sheaf associated to U maps to H^p(U, -); Descent, the comparison of fppf and Zariski cohomology for quasi-coherent modules; Cohomology of Schemes, the lemma that quasi-coherent sheaves on an affine scheme have vanishing higher cohomology
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the computation of R^p epsilon_{S,*} and R^p a_{S,*} on F^a through an affine etale covering of an arbitrary scheme over S.

core_obligations: Explain the notation (proof lines 21954-21989): by the descent equivalence there is a quasi-coherent module F_0 on S whose pullback to the big etale site restricts to F on the small etale site; since F_0^a is the pullback along the morphism of ringed sites to (S_{Zar}, O) and pullbacks compose, F^a = F_0^a, which also gives the sheaf property even for fpqc coverings.

Derive parts (2) to (5) (proof lines 21989-21993): the identifications F^a = pi_S^*F = a_S^*F and the equivalences between quasi-coherent modules on the three sites follow from the change of topology remark and the descent equivalence of quasi-coherent modules.
Part (6) (proof lines 21995-21999): the equalities epsilon_{S,*}a_S^*F = pi_S^*F and a_{S,*}a_S^*F = F are immediate from the description of F^a as the pullback of F.

Part (7) (proof lines 22001-22020): since R^p epsilon_{S,*}H is the sheaf associated to U maps to H^p_{fppf}(U, H), it suffices to find an etale covering of any U over S on which the higher fppf cohomology of F^a vanishes; taking an open affine covering, the vanishing follows from the comparison of fppf with Zariski cohomology for quasi-coherent modules and the vanishing of the higher cohomology of quasi-coherent sheaves on affine schemes.
Part (7) for a_S (proof lines 22022-22024): the argument for R^p a_{S,*}(F^a) = 0 is exactly the same as the one just given.
proof_roadmap: Identify the presheaf F^a with the pullback of a quasi-coherent module on the scheme and read off the sheaf property and parts (2)-(5).
Obtain part (6) immediately from that description.
Compute the higher direct images through an affine etale covering and the comparison with Zariski cohomology.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves seven statements identifying quasi-coherent modules on the big etale and fppf sites of a scheme S with the pullbacks of quasi-coherent modules on S, including the sheaf property for fppf coverings, the identifications with the pullbacks along pi_S and a_S, the resulting equivalences of categories, and the vanishing of the higher direct images of these pullbacks (statement lines 21926-21952). The proof (proof lines 21954-22025) identifies the presheaf with the pullback of a quasi-coherent module, derives the formal parts, and computes the higher direct images through affine etale coverings and the comparison of fppf with Zariski cohomology. H2: several independent statements with two genuine computations, written out in full.
